categories.label: Victory points on the VP track
categories.hint: Income converted 1:1 into VP during play (include the 100 VP token).

categories.label: Coins (yuán) in supply
categories.hint: 1 VP per full set of 3 coins; leftover 1-2 coins are worth nothing.

categories.label: Influence level (Traders Guild)
categories.hint: Level 0-4 on the Influence track: 0/1/4/9/16 VP.

categories.label: Border Passes (Customs Office)
categories.hint: Border Pass level 2-6 on its track: 0/1/4/9/16 VP.

categories.label: Teahouses on the board, by province
categories.labelVi: Nhà trà đã xây theo tỉnh
categories.hint: Enter how many of your Teahouses stand in each province: 1/3/6/10/15 VP. Only built Teahouses score.

categories.label: Horse position
categories.hint: Province reached by your Horse: Yunnan 0, Sichuan 1, Kang 4, Tibet 9, Qinghai 16 VP. Enter 1 (Yunnan) to 5 (Qinghai).

tiebreakers.description: Tied player with the highest Influence wins
If still tied, the tied player earlier in the current turn order wins (no shared victory)

endCondition.description: Game ends after the round in which any player reaches 80+ VP on the track, or when no Present tokens remain on the board (Expert rules: only the Present trigger, at end of round).

notes: family: auction-money. Modelled on the current Spielworxx 2023 rulebook (Standard game). Expert rules (double bidding, Guards) change only the end trigger. 2-player game uses the Duli bot, who scores nothing and is ignored. The 1st edition (Argentum, 2013) used different end-scoring (forum reports flat Teahouse VP and Customs Office/Dragon House level scoring); not modelled here - verify before using with a 2013 copy.
